entities.name: PMID:25076128
observations: Harper et al., PLoS One (2014), studied HPV4 adherence in a safety-net cohort of females aged 10–26 years.

entities.name: BMI and HPV4 completion
observations: In a historical prospective safety-net cohort of 1,240 females with BMI measurements who received at least one HPV4 dose, on-time three-dose completion was 18% in class II/III obesity versus 30% at normal BMI; odds of timely completion were lower (OR 0.55, 95% CI 0.37–0.83). This supports poorer adherence in severe obesity but does not establish a continuous BMI dose-response.
